blocks.text:
Fashion sport design with digital watches for women or lady,This watch is highly suitable for outdoor sports,running, cycling, swimming, hiking, climbing, etc.It is made of high-quality silicone and is durable.The watch face is very clear, nice and readable,The watch has a digital display with a backlight, making it easy to read in low light conditions. The watch has a stylish design and is available in a variety of colors. It is a great gift for friends and family.
Parameter
Gender: Women
Style: Fashion & Casual, Sport
Movement: Digital
Case Material: Rubber
Band Case Material: ALLOY
Clasp Type: Buckle
Material : metal & silicone
Dial Diameter: 38mm/1.49in
Case Thickness: 12 mm/0.47in
Band Width: 16mm/0.62in
Band Length: 225mm/8.85in
Water Resistance Depth: 30M
Functions: LED Light ,Chronograph, Alarm, 12/24 Hour, Date, Week, Stopwatch
Our services
With 30 days charge back, 30 days replacement policy and 1-year after sales service If you have any others troubles, please feel free to contact with us, we will respond at once with your satisfaction.
Package include:
1* High quality watch
1* Commitment Card
1* gift box

items: Simple appearance, large dial design. LED backlight display, no matter day or night, the time can be clearly displayed.

Multifunctional ladies watch, chronograph, alarm clock, 12/24 hours, date, day of the week, stopwatch, Japanese movement to keep accurate time, 3atm water resistance, scratch resistance and shock resistance.
Fashionable female digital watch, suitable for people who like to exercise, it can be used for outdoor and indoor sports or daily leisure use.
Adopt high-quality lightweight resin bezel/case/strap design, stainless steel back cover, no damage to the skin, extremely comfortable to wear.
3ATM waterproof, Not suitable for swimming. Ideal for daily use, such as hand washing and wearing in rainy conditions.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Alarm, Arabic Numerals, Easy Reader, Glow In The Dark
